description: This file defines the interface IDeviceNotify and the class DeviceResources, which manages DirectX device resources, including device creation, handling device loss, and providing accessors for various DirectX and Direct2D objects. It is part of a graphics rendering system for a Windows application using XAML, Direct3D 11, Direct2D, and related technologies.

classes.name: IDeviceNotify
classes.description: Interface for notifying when the device is lost or restored.

classes.name: DeviceResources
classes.description: Manages DirectX device resources, including creation, validation, and access to device interfaces.

methods.name: DeviceResources
methods.description: Constructor initializing device resources with a SwapChainPanel.

methods.name: SetSwapChainPanel
methods.description: Sets the SwapChainPanel used for rendering.

methods.name: SetLogicalSize
methods.description: Sets the logical size of the rendering area.

methods.name: SetDpi
methods.description: Sets the DPI (dots per inch) for rendering.

methods.name: ValidateDevice
methods.description: Validates the current device, recreating resources if needed.

methods.name: RegisterDeviceNotify
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for device events.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Trims the device resources for optimal memory usage.

methods.name: GetOutputSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the output in pixels.

methods.name: GetLogicalSize
methods.description: Returns the logical size in dips.

methods.name: GetDeviceFeatureLevel
methods.description: Returns the feature level of the device.
